ZWE.note: Nothing stated on an authentication service.

facts.fact: Minister Kazembe says the Registrar-General's Office issues birth certificates, national identity cards and death certificates and holds records of everyone, on the Zimbabwe Population Registry System that updates birth and death records in real time.
The Herald quotes Minister Kazembe saying the Zimbabwe Population Registry System is an integrated digital platform that updates birth and death records automatically in real time.
Minister Kazembe says updates on death registration enter the Zimbabwe Population Registry System automatically and in real time.

ZWE.note: Roll custody is to move to the Registrar-General and be updated from the population register; no digital roll in service, roll check or existing link stated.
No count or share of people holding an ID given.
No identity number given at birth stated.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
The voters' roll is only planned to draw on the population register; no register is stated as keyed on the ID number.
Identity cards are only mentioned as issued by the Registrar-General; nothing on the system.

facts.fact: The Herald quotes Minister Kazembe saying the Zimbabwe Population Registry System centralises national data and the Registrar-General has records of everyone.
Minister Kazembe says the system updates automatically and in real time on death registration and when citizens reach voting age.
